patch.objective: Indicators of malware, physical, and network attacks: ransomware, trojan, worm, spyware, bloatware, virus, keylogger, logic bomb, rootkit; brute force, RFID cloning, environmental; DDoS (amplified, reflected), DNS attacks, wireless, on-path, credential replay, malicious code

sources.cite: CompTIA Security+ (V7), exam SY0-701: domains General security concepts 12%, Threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigations 22%, Security architecture 18%, Security operations 28%, Security program management and oversight 20%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 for this Security+ band. The page lists the five domains and weights above, says English SY0-701 retires on June 11, 2027, and describes the topics: resilience and recovery (high availability, site considerations, testing, power, platform diversity, backups, continuity of operations); third-party risk (vendor assessment, selection, agreements, monitoring, questionnaires, rules of engagement); network attacks among the malicious activities; alerting and monitoring. The objectives PDF was not re-read; the objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: MITRE ATT&CK T1557.002, Adversary-in-the-Middle: ARP Cache Poisoning (version 1.1, last modified 24 October 2025)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch. Relevant text: mitigation M1037 'Consider enabling DHCP Snooping and Dynamic ARP Inspection on switches'; M1035 'Create static ARP entries for networked devices' (may be infeasible for large networks); detection looks for 'multiple IP addresses resolving to a single MAC' and 'unsolicited replies overriding legitimate ARP ownership'.
